content: Rep. Ritchie Torres of New York’s 15th congressional district in the Bronx introduced the Power To The Players Act this week. If passed, the bill would direct the Federal Trade Commission to establish regulations that guarantee consumers ownership of a game when they pay for it, rather than a licensing agreement. It’s increasingly common for games sold to require a connection to a server. Meaning that when a company decides to shut down those servers, the games often become unplayable. Rep. Torres singles out NBA 2K25 as a recent example. 2K will be delisting the game from storefronts at the end of the month and shutting down its servers on December 31st, limiting its playability. Concerns around ownership, the ability to play, resell, or transfer games have drawn attention recently following Sony’s announcement that it planned to phase out physical game discs in 2028. In a statement announcing the bill, Rep. Torres said, “A game that can be taken away the moment a company pulls the plug is not a purchase. It is a rental disguised as a sale.” The bill would not only give players ownership of a game, “rather than a license to play it,” but also require developers to institute an offline mode before shutting down supporting servers. That is similar to the Protect Our Games Act introduced by State Sen. John Kane in Pennsylvania, which would require companies to provide an offline gaming mode, an online gaming mode independent of the company’s servers, or a minimum 25 percent refund when titles are being sunset.
chineseTitle: 国会提出视频游戏所有权法案

chineseContent: 纽约布朗克斯区第 15 国会选区的众议员里奇·托雷斯 (Ritchie Torres) 本周提出了《球员权力法案》。如果获得通过，该法案将指示联邦贸易委员会制定法规，以保证消费者在付费时对游戏的所有权，而不是许可协议。销售的游戏需要连接到服务器的情况越来越普遍。这意味着当公司决定关闭这些服务器时，游戏通常会变得无法玩。众议员托雷斯将《NBA 2K25》作为最近的一个例子。 2K 将于本月底将该游戏从店面下架，并于 12 月 31 日关闭服务器，限制其可玩性。最近，在索尼宣布计划在 2028 年逐步淘汰实体游戏光盘后，对游戏所有权、玩游戏、转售或转让游戏的能力的担忧引起了人们的关注。众议员托雷斯在宣布该法案的一份声明中表示，“一旦公司停止服务就可以拿走的游戏不是购买，而是伪装成销售的租赁。”该法案不仅将赋予玩家游戏的所有权，“而不是玩游戏的许可”，而且还要求开发商在关闭支持服务器之前建立离线模式。这与宾夕法尼亚州参议员约翰·凯恩 (John Kane) 提出的《保护我们的游戏法案》类似，该法案要求公司提供离线游戏模式、独立于公司服务器的在线游戏模式，或者在游戏停用时提供至少 25% 的退款。
